Name: One Click News Radio
Author: xetyaj
Description:
The One Click News Radio streamlines your morning chores so that you can start the fun tasks of the day as quickly as possible. One right click on the radio brings up a single dialogue box with the daily luck announcement and tomorrow's weather forecast. Once you unlock Ginger Island, its weather forecast is automatically included in your quick update. By default, the radio also provides the weekly Queen of Sauce recipes, but you can easily configure the radio to leave them out. Version 2.+ adds configurable support for Pam's fishing channel and the Traveling Cart on their own tabs.

The One Click News Radio has twelve styles to choose from, including a plain version that can be set on the ground. Use the configuration menu to select which version best suits your decorating scheme. You do have to exit out of the game for the configuration option to take effect.

Robin sells the One Click News Radio in her shop on Wednesdays, while the Travelling Cart will randomly sell a few that have been smuggled out of the Gotoro Empire. The news radio also appears in the Furniture Catalog. 

While not a required dependency, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is highly recommended.
The News Radio mod consists of two folders that need to be copied into your installation. [CP] News Radio uses the Content Patcher to configure various game settings and upload the audio asset. The C# component is found in the News Radio folder and provides the logic to respond to user input and to deliver the required reports.

INSTALLATION
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. [b]Remove any previous versions of this mod that you may have in your installation.[/b]
4. Download the latest version of the One Click News Radio and unzip the archive.
5. Place the two new mod folders into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
6. Run the game using SMAPI.

+++++++++

INTERNATIONALIZATION

As of version 1.2.0, News Radio fully supports internationalization (i18n).
Please contact me if you'd like to collaborate to provide non-English support to the radio!

There is a French translation already available (it's very bad, I'm afraid), so if someone whose French is better than mine would like to correct my translation errors, please let me know!


+++++++++

DONATIONS
All proceeds go to [url=https://www.againstmalaria.com]Against Malaria Foundation[/url].
